unlisted_practices: Structured prompt frameworks (SPADE for dialogue generation, RTF for automated scoring) to build LLM virtual standardized patients for trainee education
Comparing LLM automated scoring against expert human scores (Spearman correlation, Bland-Altman) and restricting to formative rather than high-stakes assessment

screen.reason: The study evaluated the feasibility, scoring consistency, and user acceptance of an LLM-based virtual standardized patient (VSP) simulation tool for training clinical pharmacy trainees. It did not test a deployment practice or organizational safeguard.
